show_title: Capital Allocators – Inside the Institutional Investment Industry
title: Seth Klarman – Timeless Value Investing
summary: Seth authored the very out-of-print Margin of Safety and edited the recently released 7th edition of Graham and Dodd's value investing classic, Security Analysis. We discuss Baupost's application of value investing across sourcing, diligence, portfolio construction, and risk management. We then turn to Seth's thoughts illiquidity, international investing, the weird current environment, positioning portfolios for it, alignment with clients, succession at Baupost, and his updated persp
